papers.title_en: Subsurface schematisation from sparse CPT data using the tabular foundation model TabPFN
papers.authors: Taiga Saito, Fabian Campos Montero, Bruno Zuada Coelho, Ana Martins Teixeira, Stephen Wu, Timo Schweckendiek, Yu Otake
papers.evidence: 使用表格基础模型TabPFN进行地下剖面建模
papers.tldr: 稀疏CPT数据给地下剖面重建带来显著信息缺口。本文仅用网格坐标与土行为类型指数，调用预训练表格基础模型TabPFN，在无需岩土微调和预设层界的情况下重建二维剖面。在合成剖面与荷兰两现场，其误差接近SchemaGAN且现场更低，增加CPT数量可降低合成剖面MAE，预测区间覆盖率接近名义水平。结果表明通用表格基础模型可支持稀疏且持续更新的勘察数据地下预测，无需重训练。
papers.abstract_en: Subsurface schematisation supports geotechnical decisions but remains challenging because sparse site-investigation data leave substantial gaps in information about ground conditions. This study explores TabPFN, a foundation model pretrained on general synthetic tabular data, for this task. Using only grid coordinates and soil behaviour type index observations from sparse cone penetration tests (CPTs), we first reconstruct two-dimensional sections without geotechnical fine-tuning or predefined layer boundaries. We evaluate the approach on synthetic sections and at two field sites in the Netherlands, comparing it with SchemaGAN, a conditional generative adversarial network trained on synthetic geotechnical sections, and with reference interpolation methods. In the baseline comparisons, TabPFN achieved mean errors close to SchemaGAN's on synthetic sections and lower mean errors at both field sites. On synthetic sections, TabPFN's mean absolute error decreased at each tested increase in CPT count, and, under the baseline input setting, its pointwise prediction intervals had mean coverage close to nominal levels. Subsequent fine-tuning on the synthetic sections used to train SchemaGAN improved synthetic test accuracy but increased mean errors at both field sites. These findings indicate that general-purpose tabular foundation models offer a promising route for updating subsurface predictions from sparse and evolving site-investigation data without retraining.

papers.title_en: New Closed-Form Approximations in Statistical Mechanics Obtained by Symbolic Regression
papers.authors: Omkar Kunjir, Alina Popova, Rasul Abdusalamov, Mikhail Itskov
papers.evidence: 用符号回归框架DSO和PyOperon获得闭式近似
papers.tldr: 统计力学中复杂物理系统缺乏准确且可解析的闭式表达。本文用强化学习驱动的DSO与遗传编程PyOperon两种符号回归框架，研究蠕虫链力-伸长、ln(n!)近似和自由连接链非高斯径向密度三个问题。结果在WLC上最大相对误差降至0.05%，阶乘近似误差较九种经典方法改善约1.3×10^4倍，FJC密度较Darabi等和陡降近似分别改善11.2倍与4.6倍。所得表达式保持解析可处理，展示了符号回归发现闭式近似的互补能力。
papers.abstract_en: Obtaining accurate and analytically tractable closed-form expressions for complex physical systems remains a fundamental challenge in statistical mechanics. In this work, we investigate three approximation problems in polymer statistical mechanics using two complementary symbolic regression frameworks: Deep Symbolic Optimization (DSO), based on reinforcement learning, and PyOperon, based on genetic programming with nonlinear least-squares constant optimization. First, for the force-extension relationship of the Worm-Like Chain (WLC) model, DSO achieves a maximum relative error below 0.15%, while PyOperon reduces it to 0.05%, outperforming the Marko-Siggia formula (approximately 17%) and the Petrosyan approximation. Second, for the logarithmic factorial, ln(n!), both frameworks recover the dominant structure of Stirling's formula directly from analytical data. Using residual learning on a continued-fraction expansion of the Stirling remainder, PyOperon reduces the maximum relative error by a factor of 1.3 x 10^4 compared with the most accurate of nine classical approximations for n in [1, 30]. Third, for the non-Gaussian radial probability density of the Freely Jointed Chain (FJC) model, physics-informed residual learning improves the approximation by factors of 11.2 over Darabi et al. (2023) and 4.6 over the steepest-descent approximation. The discovered expressions remain analytically tractable across all three applications. These results demonstrate the complementary capabilities of DSO and PyOperon for discovering accurate closed-form approximations in statistical and continuum mechanics.

papers.title_en: NVIDIA Kumo Tabular: Pushing the Accuracy-Efficiency Frontier for Tabular Prediction
papers.authors: Jingang Qu, Valter Hudovernik, Martin Jurkovič, Cedric Lorenz, David Holzmüller, Federico Lopez, Dmitry Gordeev, Akihiro Nitta, Ramona Bendias, Ardrian Wong, Vedaant Jain, Vignesh Kothapalli, Gilberto Titericz Junior, Jure Leskovec, Matthias Fey
papers.evidence: 基于合成表格预训练的开放表格基础模型，用于分类与回归
papers.tldr: 表格预测领域长期依赖逐表训练，精度与效率难兼顾。NVIDIA 提出 Kumo Tabular 系列开源表格基础模型，含 S/M/L 三种规模，仅在人工表格上预训练，无需额外训练即可对新表做分类与回归。其中 Kumo Tabular-L 在 TabArena 等八个基准上排名第一，且预测速度显著快于 LimiX-2 与 TabPFN-3.5，三种规模均位于精度-速度前沿，权重与预训练代码已开源。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Kumo Tabular, a family of open tabular foundation models for classification and regression, in three sizes: Kumo Tabular-S (27M parameters), Kumo Tabular-M (61M), and Kumo Tabular-L (214M). Pretrained only on artificial tables from the Kumo prior, they can make predictions on new tables without any training. In our approach, a table encoder compresses each row into an embedding, and an in-context learning transformer predicts the unlabeled rows from the labeled ones. Kumo Tabular introduces architectural innovations that improve both training stability and predictive performance, enabling the model to scale up to 150M cells on modern GPUs. Kumo Tabular-L ranks first on eight benchmarks: TabArena, TALENT, BeyondArena, ScoringBench, STRABLE, MulTaBench, RamanBench, and TabBench-Bio. These cover probabilistic regression, tables with over 1M rows or 100K columns, and tables with strings, text, or images. Accuracy improves with model size in all tested comparisons. All three sizes lie on the accuracy-speed frontiers of TabArena and BeyondArena. Kumo Tabular-L predicts faster than the runners-up, LimiX-2 on TabArena (36 times) and TabPFN-3.5 on BeyondArena (1.7 times). Weights and pretraining code are released under OpenMDW-1.1 and Apache 2.0, respectively.

papers.title_en: Know When the Equation Is Wrong: Structural Uncertainty for LLM-Guided Symbolic Regression under Extrapolation
papers.authors: Mostafa Cham, Bayu Adhi Tama, Jianwu Wang
papers.evidence: LLM引导符号回归并量化备选方程结构的不确定性
papers.tldr: LLM引导的符号回归通常只保留单一最优方程，难以反映不同函数形式在观测内相似、外推时分歧的问题。LLM-SR-UQ保留多个竞争方程结构，以候选方程间不一致度量函数形式不确定性，并把固定宽度保形区间扩展为结构区间。实验表明标准保形区间在LLM-SRBench外推场景常失效，该方法在维持分布内覆盖的同时显著提升外推覆盖，且可迁移到其他符号回归方法。
papers.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) can help discover mathematical equations from data, but most LLM-guided symbolic regression methods focus on a single best equation without quantifying uncertainty over alternative functional forms. This is challenging because distinct equations can fit the observed data similarly while producing substantially different extrapolations. Our experiments on the LLM-SRBench dataset show that standard conformal intervals achieve nominal in-distribution coverage but frequently fail under extrapolation. To tackle this challenge, we introduce LLM-SR-UQ, a framework that retains competing equation structures and uses their disagreement to characterize uncertainty about the underlying functional form. We extend the standard fixed-width conformal approach to quantify structural intervals, which measure disagreement among candidate equations and identify where prediction intervals should widen. Extensive experiments show our framework substantially improves coverage attainment by incorporating structural disagreement while preserving in-distribution coverage. Our approach also shows good generalizability when it is applied to other symbolic-regression methods.

papers.title_en: TabAbax: A Tabular Foundation Model Technical Report
papers.authors: Zhixiong Cheng, Xiaoyun Gao, Shiyuan Han, Jingjing Suo, Zhengli Wang
papers.evidence: 可在未见表格数据上做上下文预测的表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型能对未见表格数据做上下文预测，但加深ICL主干收益有限，提升空间主要在合成预训练先验与列行编码器。TabAbax基于TabICLv2，仅改这两处：增强合成先验质量与复杂度，并用两遍列行堆叠和学习式Fourier标量编码强化特征交互。BeyondArena达1238 Elo（第10/41），TabArena总体1676 Elo（第11/99，较TabICLv2+115），回归2024 Elo（第7/99，+336）。仅改先验即回归+228 Elo，表明先验质量是主杠杆。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) enable in-context prediction on unseen tabular datasets without task-specific training. Mechanistic work has shown that increasing the depth of the ICL Transformer yields weak gains, leaving the main headroom for gains in the synthetic pretraining prior and column-row encoder upstream of the ICL backbone. We introduce TabAbax, a TFM built on TabICLv2 that focuses all modifications on these two upstream components. On the prior side, we further improve the quality and complexity of the synthetic pretraining prior. On the encoder side, a two-pass column-row stack strengthens cross-feature interactions before row compression, using learned Fourier scalar encoding from TabFM and Causilo. Evaluations on BeyondArena and TabArena show strong regression-centric gains: TabAbax reaches 1,238 Elo on the 142-dataset BeyondArena suite (10th of 41 evaluated methods), 1,676 Elo on TabArena's overall 51-dataset suite (11th of 99 methods, +115 over TabICLv2), and 2,024 Elo on TabArena's regression benchmark (7th of 99 methods, +336 over TabICLv2, +21 over TabFM). A prior-only ablation confirms the attribution: the improved prior alone yields +228 Elo for regression, demonstrating that prior quality is the dominant knob for improving regression performance.

papers.title_en: Why Tabular Foundation Models Excel on Relational Data They Have Never Seen
papers.authors: Linjie Xu, Yiqun Hu, Jixiang He, David Wipf
papers.evidence: 研究表格基础模型在关系数据上为何表现出色
papers.tldr: 企业RDB常需针对众多候选目标列反复预测，逐任务训练模型成本高，冻结表格基础模型配合无参数关系编码器有望零样本迁移。本文用更多样实验确认该组合在未见关系数据上仍具竞争力，并提出多种互补解释：编码器把关系效应映射为固定长度嵌入，近似TFM原本适配的分布，使单表后验预测等性质得以迁移。该分析为可解释、易融入代理系统的RDB基础模型设计提供新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Given a relational database (RDB) storing heterogeneous tabular information, how can we predict missing (or future) values in some target column of interest? As candidate targets are numerous in enterprise settings, it is preferable to avoid learning a new model from scratch each time there is a new prediction task. Frozen foundation models (FMs) based on in-context learning (ICL) and RDB-specific pre-training provide a viable solution, but the ideal design still remains largely unresolved. Perhaps unexpectedly, preliminary evidence has recently shown that existing single-table FMs (aka TFMs), when combined with suitable parameter-free relational encoders, can be quite competitive in practice despite zero exposure to RDB pre-training or relational data of any kind. In this work we first empirically confirm this phenomenon with a more diverse array of experiments. We then turn to our main contribution, namely, surfacing multiple complementary explanations for why TFMs behave so effectively. These explanations ultimately hinge on innate synergies whereby parameter-free encoders map relational effects to fixed-length embeddings that loosely mimic distributions for which TFMs were originally designed; in so doing, desirable single-table properties transfer to relational settings (e.g., convergent posterior predictive distributions). Collectively, our analysis forges new pathways for improving RDB FMs, particularly when we prioritize interpretability and inevitable integration within agentic systems.

papers.title_en: When, Where, How: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Christian M. M. Frey
papers.evidence: 面向表格基础模型的主动上下文学习
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型仅靠上下文中的标注行适配新任务，而真实场景标注成本高昂。本文研究主动上下文学习中多样性、预测不确定性与目标感知信息增益随冻结模型获取更多上下文的变化，并提出TANN与EPIC获取规则。在20个基准、两个TFM和经典GBDT上发现：早期多样性获取最佳，目标感知最近邻选行显著重要，EPIC在标签预算下模型最佳。EPIC仅用5-10%池标注即可保留80-87%机会校正全数据性能，并提升GBDT表现。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) adapt to a new task only through the labeled rows in their context. However, labels are expensive to acquire in real-world scenarios due to the need for highly specific domain knowledge to ensure high-quality data. Active in-context learning transfers classical acquisition rules to this setting, in which the model that guides acquisition changes with every label added. We ask how the value of diversity, predictive uncertainty and target-aware information gain changes as a frozen TFM acquires more context. For that, we study Target-Aware Nearest Neighbor (TANN) acquisition and the Expected Predictive Information Gain in Context (EPIC) and evaluate them against classical rules. Our study across twenty benchmarks with two well-established TFMs and classical GBDTs highlights three findings: (i) When: diversity-based acquisition is best during the first acquisition iterations; (ii) Where: labeling pool rows that serve the target inputs via a simple target-aware nearest-neighbor rule matters substantially; (iii) How: EPIC yields the best models at the label budget, retains on average 80--87% of the chance-corrected full-data performance with only 5-10% of the pool labeled on the eight benchmarks with the largest pools, and selects labels that also improve the predictive performance of gradient-boosted decision trees.

papers.title_en: Random Symbolic Boosting: A Geometric Approach to Symbolic Regression
papers.authors: Jos\'e R. Ortegaa, Jos\'e Manuel Mu\~noz Contreras, Leonardo Trujillo
papers.evidence: 提出用于符号回归的随机符号提升方法
papers.tldr: 符号回归模型可解释，但依赖代际进化导致构建过程计算昂贵。Random Symbolic Boosting将随机生成语法树的语义直接视为向量，通过boosting在种群上构建显式加性符号模型，并用预测与目标向量夹角做自适应几何早停。在标准符号回归基准上，它处于预测精度与训练时间的Pareto最优点，真实数据集排名第一，并在200个表格分类任务上取得有竞争力结果。该工作为高效、可解释的符号建模提供了无需代际进化的新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic models offer interpretability, but their construction through generational evolution can be computationally expensive. This article presents Random Symbolic Boosting (RSB), a method that constructs explicit additive symbolic models via boosting over populations of randomly generated syntax trees, eliminating the need for generational evolution. The idea combines two observations: high-dimensional spaces can be spanned by enough linearly independent vectors, and the semantics of syntax trees can be directly manipulated as such vectors. It is shown that, for Ordinary Least Squares, the boosting process guarantees a monotonic reduction of the training error for both regression and classification. Furthermore, an adaptive geometric early stopping mechanism is introduced. It is based on the angle between the prediction and target vectors, is independent of the problems scale, and requires no adjustments across tasks. Evaluated on a standard benchmark for symbolic regression, the method is located at the Pareto-optimal point between predictive accuracy and training time, ranking first on the real-world datasets. Additionally, it was tested on a large tabular classification benchmark with 200 problems, achieving competitive results.

papers.title_en: RAD-TFM: Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Matthew Peroni, Franck Le, Vadim Sheinin
papers.evidence: 基于合成数据预训练的鲁棒且领域自适应的表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型（TFM）常依赖合成数据预训练，但现有生成器设计多追求整体性能，缺少对困难样本和真实领域的针对性。RAD-TFM将生成器分布参数化，用最优性差距引导对抗式持续训练，并约束合成数据贴近目标领域。应用于TabPFN V2后，在6个基准上平均归一化AUC最高提升10.8个百分点，仅需不到10万额外合成数据集；TabICL V2上同样有效。该框架为仅用合成数据定向增强TFM提供了通用方案。
papers.abstract_en: The development of tabular foundation models (TFMs) has accelerated in recent years, outperforming traditional ML methods on many tabular benchmarks. A key finding is that TFMs can be pretrained entirely on synthetic datasets, opening opportunities to design data generators that encourage desirable model properties. Prior work has mainly focused on crafting high-quality priors over generators to improve overall pretraining performance. Our key insight is that parameterizing the generator distribution enables an adversarial, distributional robustness perspective: during training, we can adapt the generator to emphasize datasets that are particularly challenging for the model, which we formalize by introducing an optimality gap measure. Further, we develop a method to align the synthetic data generation with real-world datasets from a given domain, constraining the adversary to generate realistic data. Together, these algorithms comprise the Robust and Domain-Adapted Tabular Foundation Models (RAD-TFM) pipeline, a model-agnostic adversarial training framework. Applied to the TabPFN V2 classifier, RAD-TFM improves performance across 6 diverse tabular benchmarks, with up to a 10.8 percentage-point improvement in mean normalized AUC over the strongest baseline, using fewer than 100k additional synthetic training datasets, less than 0.1% of the original pretraining data. Applying the same pipeline to TabICL V2 also improves performance across three major benchmarks, demonstrating the generality of the framework. These results highlight a promising new direction for targeted adversarial continued training of TFMs using synthetic data alone.

papers.title_en: Out-of-the-Box Tabular Foundation Models for Bayesian Optimization in Materials Discovery
papers.authors: Klemens Fl\"oge, Simon Bing, Leo Grinsztajn, Eliott Kalfon, Lennart Purucker, Noah Hollmann, Frank Hutter
papers.evidence: 评估TabPFN与TabICL表格基础模型作代理
papers.tldr: 在材料发现的主动学习流程中，贝叶斯优化常依赖高斯过程代理模型，但核函数选择依赖任务且复杂关系建模能力有限。本文评估表格基础模型 TabPFN 与 TabICL 作为开箱即用代理模型，在两个材料科学基准上与高斯过程、随机森林和 CatBoost 等基线比较。结果显示，无需主动学习任务训练或高斯过程核选择，两类模型仍具高度竞争力。该工作支持将表格基础模型进一步发展為材料主动学习代理。
papers.abstract_en: Bayesian optimization is widely used in active learning loops for materials science. Gaussian processes serve as the de-facto surrogate model family, but require task-dependent kernel choices and can lack the modeling capacity for complex relationships. Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as the state-of-the-art for predictive tasks on structured data, without requiring bespoke kernels or hyperparameter tuning. We evaluate two TFMs, TabPFN and TabICL, as out-of-the-box surrogate models on two standard materials science benchmarks, comparing against a large field of baselines encompassing Gaussian processes, random forests, and CatBoost. Our findings indicate that TFMs are highly competitive surrogate models across the two benchmarks, without task-specific training for active learning or GP kernel selection. Our results motivate developing TFMs further as surrogates for active learning in materials discovery.

papers.title_en: Tabular Foundation Models in Financial Predictions
papers.authors: Ed deHaan, Allen H. Huang
papers.evidence: 引入并评估用于财务预测的表格基础模型
papers.tldr: 会计研究需要可靠且易用的盈利变化预测工具。本文引入表格基础模型TFM，在预测企业下一年盈利变化的任务上检验其表现，并与微调开源大语言模型及多种树模型比较。TabFM准确率最高，且比大语言模型更快、算力需求更低；部分树模型速度更快，但需权衡精度。研究表明TFM可作为会计与金融预测的新工具，但结论仅基于单一基准任务。
papers.abstract_en: This technical note introduces tabular foundation models (TFMs) to accounting research and evaluates their performance in one common benchmark task: predicting firms' next-year earnings changes. TFMs produce numeric predictions and learn in context, without post-release training or tuning, making them natural and easy to use for forecasting. The TFMs we study are pretrained on synthetic tabular data, so they avoid look-ahead bias from memorizing firms' outcomes. We compare Google Research's TabFM with a fine-tuned open-weight large language model developed in recent accounting research and with several tree-based models. TabFM is more accurate than all comparison models. It is also faster and less computationally intensive than the large language model. Several tree-based specifications produce predictions more quickly than TabFM, so choosing between them involves a trade-off between accuracy and speed. We conclude that TFMs have promise as a new tool for forecasting in accounting and finance. However, our evaluation is based on a single benchmark task, and no class of models is likely to dominate in all settings.

papers.title_en: TSGP-2: On the Non-Linearity of Symbolic Regression Problems and How to Exploit It with Model-based Semantic Genetic Programming
papers.authors: Philipp Anthes, Alina Geiger, Martin Briesch, Franz Rothlauf
papers.evidence: 用语义遗传编程分析符号回归问题的非线性
papers.tldr: 符号回归中，TSGP 的模型变异算子因训练数据偏向线性程序而倾向产生线性后代，可能拖累非线性问题求解。作者先分析 Feynman 与真实世界基准的线性程度，发现后者多可线性近似而前者含不同非线性结构。随后提出 TSGP-2，用线性和非线性目标函数的 GP 运行程序共同训练变异算子。实验显示其在非线性问题上优于 TSGP、线性问题上相近，并更早生成有意义的非线性后代，说明训练数据偏置需与问题匹配。
papers.abstract_en: Model-based variation operators such as the one used in Transformer Semantic Genetic Programming (TSGP) are affected by possible biases of their training data. TSGP is trained on programs generated by Genetic Programming (GP) runs on linear target functions, which leads to a bias toward linear offspring. This bias can hinder search performance on problems that require non-linear solutions. This work has two goals: first, we investigate the linearity of standard benchmark problems including the Feynman and real-world problems. While most of the structure of real-world problems can be well approximated by linear functions, the Feynman problems exhibit varying levels of non-linear structure. Thus, a proper variation operator of a search method should be able to create both types of programs, linear as well as non-linear ones. Second, we propose TSGP-2, which follows the functionality of TSGP but uses as training data programs from GP runs on both linear and non-linear target functions. As a result, the training data includes a lower share of programs that behave linearly. With a higher share of non-linear structures, TSGP-2 outperforms TSGP on problems with non-linear structure, while performing similarly on linear problems. In addition, TSGP-2 is less biased toward linear offspring and is able to propose a higher number of meaningful non-linear offspring earlier during search, which coincides with better solutions. The findings underscore the importance of training data for a learned variation operator and emphasize that the biases of search operators should be aligned with the problems they are applied to.

papers.title_en: CoSyDelay: Cognitive Symbolic Regression for Traffic Delay Estimation
papers.authors: Lindong Xie, Xiexin Zou, Yang Zhang, Beiyu Song, Zeren Xing, Edward Chung
papers.evidence: 应用于交通延误估计的认知符号回归框架
papers.tldr: 信号交叉口延误估计是主动交通控制与拥堵缓解的重要基础，但解析模型依赖理想假设，数据驱动模型虽精度较高却缺乏透明结构。CoSyDelay将交叉口级延误估计分解为转向级子问题，利用领域知识构造符号输入，并以大语言模型作为符号搜索算子迭代生成和优化候选表达式，再用进口道延误标签校准系数。在多个信号交叉口的实验表明，所得表达式具有有竞争力的估计精度，并满足交通延误原理、保持物理一致性。该框架导出显式可解释延误估计式，提升实际应用可信度。
papers.abstract_en: Trustworthy estimation of traffic delays at signalized intersections is critical for modern transportation systems, as it supports proactive traffic control for congestion mitigation. Existing analytical methods often rely on idealized assumptions that limit their accuracy under complex traffic conditions, whereas data-driven methods may achieve strong estimation performance but usually lack transparent structures, which reduces confidence in their practical application. To address these limitations, we propose CoSyDelay, a cognitive symbolic regression (SR) framework for automatically deriving explicit and physically consistent empirical delay estimation expressions (DEEs). Specifically, CoSyDelay decomposes intersection-level delay estimation into turning-movement-level subproblems, thereby reducing the complexity of the symbolic search. During DEE learning, CoSyDelay constructs domain-informed symbolic inputs from traffic variables. Large language models (LLMs) are employed as symbolic search operators to iteratively generate and refine candidate expression structures, whose movement-specific coefficients are subsequently calibrated using approach-level delay labels. A composite fitness function evaluates the learned DEEs jointly in terms of estimation accuracy and compliance with specified traffic-delay principles. Experimental results on multiple signalized intersections demonstrate that the resulting expressions achieve competitive estimation performance while maintaining physical consistency, thereby supporting trustworthy delay estimation. Source code and datasets are available at https://github.com/ForrestXie9/CoSyDelay.

papers.title_en: Towards Reliable Scaling Laws for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Johannes Hog, Neeratyoy Mallik, Steven Adriaensen, Jan Hendrik Metzen, Tom Viering, Danny Stoll, Frank Hutter
papers.evidence: 表格基础模型的缩放律研究
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型（TFM）依赖合成数据预训练、却在真实数据集评估，其缩放律能否外推尚不清楚。作者系统检验TabPFNv2类模型的缩放行为，比较合成与真实评估差异并分析评估数据集数量影响。结果显示拟合良好的缩放律未必给出可靠处方，过少评估集会导致乐观偏差；扩大预训练数据规模与行列采样范围可改善性能与可预测性。该工作为更高效训练nanoTabPFN类模型提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling laws are widely used to predict foundation model performance and guide compute allocation. However, tabular foundation models (TFMs) differ from conventional foundation models in that they are pretrained on virtually unlimited synthetic data from configurable distributions, while ultimately being evaluated on real-world datasets. We investigate whether scaling laws for TabPFNv2-style models reliably extrapolate to larger compute budgets and generalize across evaluation settings. Our analysis reveals differences between synthetic and real-world scaling behavior and shows that accurately fitting a scaling law does not necessarily yield reliable prescriptions on unseen datasets. In particular, selecting configurations using too few evaluation datasets leads to systematically over-optimistic performance estimates. We further demonstrate that compute-optimal scaling requires expanding the range of synthetic pretraining dataset sizes alongside model size and training compute. Increasing the maximum numbers of rows and features sampled during pretraining improves performance and produces more predictable scaling trends. These insights guide the training of more efficient TabPFNv2-like models, using the open-source training pipeline of nanoTabPFN.

papers.title_en: Targeted In-Context Poisoning of Tabular Foundation Models: An Empirical Study
papers.authors: Adem Alparslan
papers.evidence: 针对表格基础模型的上下文投毒研究
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型（TFM）在预测时依赖带标签上下文，因而上下文成为可被写入的攻击面。作者研究定向上下文投毒：向上下文源写入目标行的错误标签副本，并在30个OpenML二分类数据集上评估。单条毒行平均翻转TabICL 53%、TabPFN 65%原本正确的预测，三条毒行几乎全部翻转，且其余行性能几乎不变。论文揭示投毒在预测时生效并可事后删除，提出访问控制、逐预测追溯与预测时校验等防护要求。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) predict the label of a query row conditioned on a context of labelled rows, without training on them. Drawn from operational data, the context becomes an attack surface. We study targeted in-context poisoning in its simplest form: an attacker with write access to the context's source places exact copies of a target row there with the wrong label. On 30 OpenML datasets for binary classification, one such poison row flips on average 53% (TabICL) and 65% (TabPFN) of the predictions correct without attack, and three poison rows flip almost all. The same copy with the true label flips almost none, and performance on the remaining rows hardly changes. Predictions flip by two routes: in TabICL, the target row's embedding rotates towards the mean of the wrong class; in TabPFN, the poison row pulls genuine rows of the wrong class along. The TFMs thus infer soundly, but from forged evidence. Predictions of trained models flip as well: almost always for a random forest, for CatBoost as often as for the TFMs, hardly for a logistic regression. New with TFMs is not the kind of vulnerability but the timing: the data take effect at the moment of prediction, not through training, and a poison row in a live context can be deleted afterwards. Three established requirements must therefore cover the context: access control for its source, traceability per prediction, which can also deter, and validation at prediction time. A detection mechanism shows how such validation can work.

papers.title_en: Tabular Foundation Models for Weighted Regression and Classification
papers.authors: Junwen Xia, Yan He, Dehan Kong, Zhenhua Lin
papers.evidence: 将表格基础模型用于加权回归与分类
papers.tldr: 加权回归与分类在缺失数据分析、因果推断和保险定价等场景中很重要，但现有灵活非线性方法需在每个数据集上重新拟合并调参，成本较高，表格基础模型又无法使用样本权重。作者通过加权注意力、归一化加权损失以及在缺失数据合成加权任务上预训练，将 TabPFN-3.5 改造成 WeightedPFN。在真实缺失数据和分布外因果任务上，该方法表现强劲，运行速度约与线性基线相当。理论分析还表明，预训练的加权 Transformer 在新数据上无需再拟合即可达到加权回归的非参数极小极大速率。
papers.abstract_en: Weighted regression and classification have applications ranging from missing-data analysis and causal inference to insurance pricing and particle physics. Existing weighted methods must be fitted and tuned on each dataset, which is costly for flexible nonlinear learners. Tabular foundation models avoid this cost. A Transformer is pretrained once on many simulated datasets and then predicts on a new dataset by in-context learning, using its observations as context without further fitting. Recent models such as TabPFN-3.5 surpass tuned conventional methods, but they cannot use sample weights. We develop a general pipeline that adapts such models to weighted prediction through weighted attention, a normalized weighted loss, and pretraining on synthetic weighted prediction tasks from missing-data problems. Applied to TabPFN-3.5, it yields WeightedPFN, which performs strongly on real datasets, both in missing-data problems and in out-of-distribution causal tasks, while running about as fast as linear baselines. We also establish a statistical theory showing that a suitably pretrained weighted Transformer attains the nonparametric minimax rate for weighted regression on new datasets without further fitting.

papers.title_en: TabCUQ: Context-Uncertainty Quantification for Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yuebei Shi, Molei Liu, Zijian Guo
papers.evidence: 面向表格基础模型的上下文不确定性量化
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型依赖上下文学习给出条件期望与平均处理效应，但科学决策需要可靠不确定性量化。现有预测离散度难以同时刻画有限上下文偏差与推理小样本带来的上下文变异，普通自助法易高估、子抽样易低估。TabCUQ通过向观测结果注入噪声并让基础模型处理扰动上下文，结合wild-bootstrap离散度与最大偏差分别估计两类不确定性。模拟中覆盖显著改善，真实任务也提升参考函数覆盖。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular foundation models use in-context learning to estimate conditional expected outcomes and average treatment effects for specific groups of individuals. Using these estimates to guide scientific decisions requires reliable uncertainty quantification. The challenge is to account simultaneously for two sources of uncertainty: limited-context bias and context variation arising from the small labeled sample supplied at inference. Predictive spread does not directly quantify both sources of uncertainty, and we observe that the ordinary bootstrap may substantially overestimate context variation, whereas subsampling may underestimate it. We introduce TabCUQ, a perturbation-based framework that injects noise into observed outcomes and applies the foundation model to the perturbed contexts. TabCUQ estimates context variation using wild-bootstrap dispersion and accounts for limited-context bias using the maximum deviation between perturbed and original estimates. For a kernel-regression analogue whose estimation error admits an exact decomposition into these two components, we show that our framework provides asymptotically valid pointwise coverage. In simulations, TabCUQ substantially improves coverage, with average interval widths typically about twice those of an oracle bias-aware benchmark. Across seven real-world tasks, it also improves coverage of reference functions learned from much larger samples.

papers.title_en: ElTab: Elastically Looped Tabular Transformers
papers.authors: Mieszko Komisarczyk, Saurabh Mathur, Maurice Kraus, Sriraam Natarajan, Kristian Kersting
papers.evidence: 弹性循环表格Transformer提升TabPFN类表格基础模型效率
papers.tldr: 表格 Transformer（如 TabPFN）预测强但推理开销大，难以部署在资源受限环境。循环 Transformer 靠权重共享减少参数，但过早停止会损失显著预测能力。为此提出 ElTab，通过在随机采样的提前退出处施加监督，训练单一模型适应不同计算预算。在 30 个 OpenML 分类数据集上，单模型匹配六个特定深度模型，训练成本减半，并以少 25% 推理 FLOPs 匹配 12 层 TabPFN 基线。
papers.abstract_en: Tabular transformer models such as TabPFN achieve strong predictive performance but incur substantial inference costs, making them difficult to deploy in resource-constrained settings. While looped transformers reduce parameter count through weight sharing, they can lose significant predictive power when stopped early. To address this challenge, we introduce the Elastically Looped Tabular Transformer (ElTab), a single model trained to operate across different computational budgets through supervision at randomly sampled early exits. Across 30 OpenML classification datasets, a single ElTab model matches six depth-specific looped models while cutting training cost by more than half, and matches a 12-layer TabPFN-style baseline with 25% fewer inference FLOPs. These results show that elastic-depth training yields a single model that adapts to the deployment budget at hand, offering a favorable trade-off among predictive performance, storage, and computational cost.

papers.title_en: CCD: Context-Calibrated Open-Entity Out-of-Distribution Detection in In-Context Tabular Foundation Models
papers.authors: Zhangkai Wu, Xu Zhang, Zhihao Hao, Zhihong Cui, Yongmin Yoo, Xianxun Zhu, Kaize Shi
papers.evidence: 面向TabPFN等上下文表格基础模型的分布外检测
papers.tldr: 面向Web表格应用，上下文表格基础模型需做开放实体OOD检测：新实体不应被误判为未知类，未知类仍需被捕获。现有检测器受实体-类别偏置影响，且随机划分掩盖问题。作者提出CCD，用组外交换在分布内数据上校准三种距离与置信度，模型冻结且不用OOD数据。在NEO-Tab的14个分组/时序表上，CCD各项指标均优于16个检测器，并在三个TFM骨干上保持领先。
papers.abstract_en: In-context tabular foundation models (TFMs), such as TabPFN, predict from a labelled context without updating their parameters and are increasingly used for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in Web applications, whose test rows come from entities absent from that context. Such applications need open-entity OOD detection: a new entity must not be mistaken for an unknown class, and an unknown class must still be caught. Existing detectors fail in this setting, and an entity-split gap hides the failure: random splits also place the test entities in the context. The failure arises because every TFM score reflects how unfamiliar a row is to the context. This produces an entity-over-class bias: known-class rows of new entities look more OOD than familiar ones, sometimes more than unknown classes. Specifically, the two OOD scores most widely used with in-context TFMs face an entity-class trade-off: the TFM's predictive confidence misses unknown classes, whereas the distance of a test row to the context flags new entities. To address this problem, we hold a group of entities out of the context and score them with the remaining context, which turns them into new entities of known classes and tells us how such rows should score. To measure detection on new entities, we build NEO-Tab (New-Entity OOD detection on Tables), 14 grouped and temporal tables on which all test rows come from new entities. We then propose Context-Calibrated Detection (CCD), which uses these group-out swaps on in-distribution data to calibrate three distances and the confidence against new-entity references. CCD weights them by their sensitivity and sharpness, keeps the model frozen and uses no OOD data. On NEO-Tab, CCD outperforms 16 existing detectors on every metric we report, and its lead holds on three TFM backbones.

papers.title_en: Evolving Explanations: Complexity-Adaptive Refinement of Faithful Explanations for Symbolic Regression
papers.authors: Elisabeth Mayrhuber, Ting Hu, Stephan Winkler
papers.evidence: 面向符号回归的忠实解释复杂度自适应细化
papers.tldr: LLM为符号回归生成的自然语言解释常流畅却不忠实于底层模型，形成忠实性缺口。本文提出复杂度自适应精炼框架：解释器LLM逐级增加细节，独立验证器LLM抽取符号表达式并与原模型数值比对，将解释生成视为带忠实性约束的离散搜索。在真实与合成数据集250次运行中整体通过率达84.0%，多数解释在低复杂度即收敛。结果表明，显式闭环符号验证能以最小必要复杂度获得忠实解释。
papers.abstract_en: Natural-language explanations generated by large language models (LLMs) for machine learning models often seem fluent but are not necessarily faithful to the underlying model. We formalize this mismatch as a faithfulness gap and propose a complexity-adaptive refinement framework for symbolic regression that iteratively generates and validates explanations until numerical agreement with the target expression is achieved. The approach follows a two-stage pipeline: an explainer LLM produces textual descriptions at increasing levels of detail, while an independent validator LLM extracts a symbolic expression that is compared against the original model. This process is framed as a discrete search over explanation space, where complexity is minimized subject to a faithfulness constraint. We evaluate the method on real-world and synthetic datasets, with a total of 250 runs across varying model complexities. The explanation refinement loop achieves an overall pass rate of 84.0%, with most explanations converging at low complexity levels and only a small fraction requiring detailed descriptions. Our results demonstrate that faithful explanations can be obtained with minimal necessary complexity by explicitly closing the explanation loop through symbolic validation.

papers.title_en: Beyond Foundation Models: PFN Priors Improve Tabular Hyperparameter Optimization
papers.authors: Artem Chistyakov, Renat Sergazinov, Artem Babenko
papers.evidence: 利用表格基础模型预训练的PFN合成先验做超参数调优
papers.tldr: 现有 PFN 合成先验主要用于预训练表格基础模型，本文探究其能否提升逐数据集训练的常规表格模型。提出 PriorTune，仅在合成任务上元调优超参数配置，离线拟合并贪心筛选胜率最高的配置子集，在线仅拟合该子集且不增加额外成本。实验发现配置数与合成数据量具同等扩展效应；在 BeyondArena 上，LightGBM+TabPrep 配置排名超过 TabPFN-3 与 RealMLP，推理更高效。结果表明 PFN 先验可作为非基础表格模型超参选择的规模化元训练数据源。
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic priors have so far served one purpose: pretraining tabular foundation models. We ask whether the same priors can improve conventional tabular models, which are trained from scratch on each dataset. We propose PriorTune, a method that meta-tunes hyperparameter configurations on synthetic tasks alone. Offline, for a given model, we fit a pool of configurations on datasets sampled from a published PFN prior and greedily select the subset with the highest winrate over the random baseline. Online, a new dataset fits only the selected configurations, so the gain comes at no extra cost. Empirically, we observe that scaling both the number of configurations and synthetic datasets has an equal scaling effect on the performance of the final subset of configurations, which we also explain theoretically. On the full BeyondArena benchmark, LightGBM with TabPrep features with our configurations ranks above TabPFN-3 and RealMLP, while being much more efficient at inference. Overall, our results establish existing PFN priors as a scalable source of meta-training data for hyperparameter selection for non-foundational tabular models.

papers.title_en: PH-Symb : Sparse symbolic identification of nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems using Kolmogorov-Arnold networks
papers.authors: Achraf El Messaoudi, Karim Cherifi, Yann Le Gorrec, Yongxin Wu
papers.evidence: 稀疏符号辨识，从数据中恢复显式符号模型
papers.tldr: 非线性端口哈密顿系统从数据辨识时，常面临模型不可解释或结构难保持的问题。PH-Symb将Kolmogorov-Arnold网络与稀疏回归结合，直接构建显式符号化的端口哈密顿模型，并用新归一化方法在训练中保持pH结构。它同时支持输入-状态-输出和输入-输出数据，在合成与真实系统上取得比神经基线更低的误差和可解释模型。该工作为结构保持的符号辨识提供了可解释且低误差的新方案。
papers.abstract_en: The paper introduces PH-Symb, a novel symbolic structure-preserving identification method, that combines Kolmogorov Arnold networks and sparse regression to build explicit port-Hamiltonian (pH) models from data. Unlike other Machine Learning or neural pH approaches, PH-Symb recovers physically interpretable and explicit-symbolic components and enforces pH structure by construction. It also introduces a new normalization method that preserves the pH structure. It allows handling both identification from input-state-output (ISO) data and input-output (IO) data, and applications show it delivers interpretable models and lower errors than neural baselines on synthetic and real-world systems.

papers.title_en: Causal discovery from Bayesian symbolic regression
papers.authors: Roger Guimer\`a, Kai-Hendrik Cohrs, Sergio Pedreira, Marta Sales-Pardo, Gustau Camps-Valls
papers.evidence: 将因果发现重构为贝叶斯符号回归问题
papers.tldr: 现有约束与评分式因果发现常仅恢复Markov等价类，在双变量或强自相关场景缺乏信号。本文把因果发现转化为贝叶斯符号回归，对每个目标变量的候选父变量采样闭式表达式，以后验包含概率作为因果分数。在耦合非线性双变量、CauseMe多场景及四变量生物地球科学结构因果模型上，该方法具竞争力且常优于专用算法，并能给出可解释的闭式机制。
papers.abstract_en: Causal discovery from observational data is central to scientific reasoning, yet established constraint-based and score-based methods often recover only a Markov equivalence class and provide no signal in bivariate or strongly autocorrelated regimes typical in some areas of science. Here, we recast causal discovery as a Bayesian symbolic regression problem. Given a set of candidate parents for each target variable, the Bayesian symbolic regression samples closed-form expressions from a posterior over symbolic models. The fraction of sampled expressions in which each candidate variable appears defines a posterior inclusion probability that we use as the causal score. This replaces pointwise model selection by an ensemble of plausible mechanisms. We evaluate the method on coupled nonlinear bivariate dynamics, on the CauseMe benchmark suite spanning linear, chaotic, nonlinear, higher-dimensional and high-noise settings, and on a four-variable biogeoscience structural causal model under Gaussian, heavy-tailed and mixed-noise regimes. Our approach is competitive with, and often outperforms, specialized causal discovery algorithms. Additionally, the method returns closed-form mechanisms leading to explicit causality and interpretability.

papers.title_en: Variable Importance Recovery in Tabular Foundation Models: A Simulation Study
papers.authors: Vasil Yasenov, Nicholas Adams-Cohen
papers.evidence: 表格基础模型中变量重要性恢复的蒙特卡洛模拟研究
papers.tldr: 表格基础模型在中小型表格数据上预测表现突出，但其能否恢复总体变量重要性尚缺系统评估。研究设计蒙特卡洛模拟，区分多种总体估计量，并为每种匹配模型无关的重要性估计器，从排序、支持集和相对幅度评估恢复效果。结果显示表格基础模型总体与调优梯度提升树等基线竞争力相当，且常更准确。该工作把证据扩展到变量重要性恢复维度，增强其应用吸引力。
papers.abstract_en: In machine learning, identifying which variables contribute predictive information can be as important as predictive accuracy. Tabular foundation models have matched or exceeded the predictive performance of tuned gradient boosting trees on many small- and medium-sized tabular datasets. Yet their ability to recover population-level variable importance has received little attention. We design and conduct a Monte Carlo simulation study to compare variable importance recovery across tabular foundation models and established machine learning baselines. Our framework distinguishes multiple population estimands, pairs each one with an aligned model-agnostic importance estimator, and evaluates recovery in terms of ranking, support, and relative magnitude. Our results show that tabular foundation models are generally competitive with established machine-learning baselines in recovering population variable importance, and often more accurate. We thus extend the evidence for their capabilities to a previously underexamined dimension, further strengthening their appeal.

papers.title_en: One Table, Many Queries: Benchmarking Generalist Tabular Models Across Generation, Imputation, and Prediction
papers.authors: Yuanrui Wang, Kaifang Li, Xuanyue Li, Ziyun Li, Yan Lu, Xingxuan Zhang, Peng Cui
papers.evidence: 跨生成、插补与预测的通用表格模型基准评测
papers.tldr: 表格生成、插补与预测常被分开评测，难以判断模型能否兼顾。本文提出One Table Benchmark，覆盖56个数据集、46种方法与20项能力轴，并在对齐划分和任务契约下比较排名、目标组合与专家组合。结果显示插补与预测经数值恢复和依赖保持相连，生成经预测效用关联二者，但分布保真排名不同；固定通用模型在效用上可超专家组合，保真仍偏向专门化。该基准为统一表格模型揭示共享条件信息与短板。
papers.abstract_en: Generation, imputation, and prediction query different aspects of the same tabular distribution, but are usually evaluated separately. This leaves unclear which capabilities they share, how their training objectives interact, and whether one model can perform all three well. We introduce the One Table Benchmark (\ours{}), spanning 56 datasets, 46 registered methods, and 20 capability axes under aligned data splits and explicit task contracts. We compare task ranks on aligned support, train five backbones under all seven non-empty objective combinations on five datasets with three seeds, and contrast fixed-model profiles with specialist portfolios. Rank comparisons connect imputation and prediction through numerical recovery and dependence preservation, and link generation to both through predictive utility; distributional fidelity follows different, sometimes opposing, rankings. Objective interventions show the largest pooled gains from including the recipient's own objective. Generation has the broadest coverage of positive pooled auxiliary effects, while prediction shows potential to improve imputation and synthetic-data utility, with responses that vary across backbones. Cross-addition effects reveal that objective benefits need not add and depend on the objectives already present. Fixed-model comparisons expose corresponding utility--fidelity trade-offs: some generalists surpass specialist portfolios on utility, while fidelity continues to favor specialization. Frozen foundation models show strong prediction and numerical point imputation, together with promising synthetic-data utility, highlighting their potential across all three tasks. These findings motivate unified tabular models that share useful conditional information while improving categorical reconstruction and faithful joint sampling.

papers.title_en: SLyM: LLM-Driven Symbolic Lyapunov Function Discovery via Structure Proposal and Coefficient Optimization
papers.authors: Zihao Fu, Xingchen Li, Keyou You
papers.evidence: 以大模型提出结构、优化求解系数的符号函数自动发现
papers.tldr: 李雅普诺夫函数是动力系统稳定性分析的核心，但符号形式合成缺乏通用构造算法。SLyM将构造拆成结构提议与系数优化：由LLM依据先验知识提出函数结构，系数通过凸规划求解，并把局部搜索得到的结构回流为监督以扩展覆盖。在全部基准上，SLyM稳定优于所评估的神经、平方和与生成式基线，为LLM驱动符号稳定性证书发现提供了新范式。
papers.abstract_en: Lyapunov functions are the cornerstone of stability analysis for dynamical systems, yet synthesizing a symbolic form remains difficult as no universal constructive algorithm exists. To address this challenge, we introduce SLyM, a framework that harnesses the knowledge and reasoning of large language models (LLMs) to discover symbolic Lyapunov functions. To avoid charging the LLM with ill-suited numerical generation, SLyM decomposes the construction into structure proposal and coefficient optimization: the LLM draws on its prior knowledge of Lyapunov constructions to propose the function structure, whose coefficients then follow from a convex program. Local-search structures are folded back into supervision, extending coverage to systems missed by the initial proposer. Across all benchmarks, SLyM consistently outperforms the evaluated neural, sum-of-squares, and generative baselines.

papers.title_en: PFN-Syn: Generating Synthetic Tabular Data with Prior-Data Fitted Networks
papers.authors: Michael Zuo, Inwon Kang, Oshani Seneviratne, Stacy Patterson
papers.evidence: 基于先验数据拟合网络的合成表格数据生成
papers.tldr: 隐私敏感领域的表格数据共享常受限于现有生成器需数据集特定训练且计算开销大。PFN-Syn基于prior-data fitted networks构建免训练合成表格数据生成框架。在八个二分类数据集上，其平均下游效用优于对比生成器，吞吐量高于训练型基线，并保持有竞争力的分布相似性与最近记录距离隐私表现。这表明表格基础模型可作为实用合成数据生成的可复用构件。
papers.abstract_en: Synthetic tabular data can help enable data sharing and model development in privacy-sensitive domains, but existing generators often require dataset-specific training and substantial computation. We introduce PFN-Syn, a training-free framework for synthetic tabular data generation based on prior-data fitted networks. We evaluate PFN-Syn against training-based generators on eight binary classification datasets. PFN-Syn achieves the highest average downstream utility among evaluated synthetic generators, with higher generation throughput than training-based baselines, while maintaining competitive distributional similarity and distance-to-closest-record privacy behavior. Our results suggest that tabular foundation models can serve as useful building blocks for practical synthetic tabular data generation.
